fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Prometaal works with recyclable materials, collection and logistics for business customers, so the first question is often operational: what material is involved and how should it be handled? Sustainability information matters, but it cannot replace details about collection, transport or the type of recycling service a company needs.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Prometaal around the material and service questions that business customers are likely to know first. Recyclable materials, collection and logistics each have a clear place, while sustainability context supports the process instead of becoming the only message. This keeps the main route understandable while deeper detail remains available when needed.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Blenco sells made-to-measure window decoration, which means customers cannot simply choose a product and add a standard quantity to the cart. Product type, fabric or style, colour, measurements and mounting choices all affect what is being ordered.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured Blenco so customers configure a made-to-measure product step by step instead of confronting every option at once. Product type and visual choices come first, followed by colour, measurements and mounting preferences. Relevant actions remain close to the information needed for the next step.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: C10media works across outdoor media, digital, radio, television and print, so a client may arrive with a campaign goal rather than a preferred channel. Listing every medium at the same level would force visitors to design their own media plan before they understand where the agency can help.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I designed C10media around the campaign decision rather than around a long inventory of media products. Strategy gives the starting context, while outdoor, digital, radio, television and print can each explain where they fit. The same hierarchy keeps the next action visible without adding unnecessary decision points.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Visitors can arrive with different service needs and locations, so company listings alone are not enough. The platform needs to connect a request with relevant providers, comparable information and a clear quotation route without making the discovery process unnecessarily complex.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I shaped the platform around service selection, local relevance and quotation requests. Visitors can move from their need to suitable provider information and request quotes from multiple businesses, while reviews and pricing support comparison. On mobile, provider content, forms and next actions remain easy to follow.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Customers need to compare different levels of car care, understand pricing and decide whether to walk in, request a quote or plan a visit. Strong visual branding therefore had to work alongside practical service information rather than push it out of view.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged six car-care services into distinct routes and kept pricing, location information and next actions close to each decision. Visitors can choose between walk-in service and planned booking, while the two locations remain easy to find. The responsive structure keeps those practical choices prominent on mobile.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Taxicentralerijswijk serves passengers with transport needs, including local rides, airport journeys and business travel. An airport passenger needs flight-related clarity, while a local passenger may care about pickup, destination and quick contact.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured Taxicentralerijswijk around the type of journey a passenger is planning. Local rides, airport transport and business travel have their own context, so visitors can understand what information belongs to the request before opening a booking or contact route.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Vanbachfinance needs to explain financial support to businesses that may arrive with questions about administration, reporting, tax work or finance guidance. These topics are connected, but a visitor should not have to understand internal structure before finding the relevant service.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I designed Vanbachfinance around the financial tasks clients are likely to recognise first. Administration, reporting, tax support and finance guidance each receive a clear route, with supporting information added where it helps someone decide whether the service fits their question.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Werkenbijalpinadrive is a recruitment site for driving professionals, so candidates need more than a list of open roles. They want to understand the employer, the type of driving work, practical conditions and what the application process looks like before sharing their details.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I shaped Werkenbijalpinadrive around the candidate's decision sequence. Employer information and the reality of the work provide context first, while vacancies lead into role details and a direct application path. Supporting information stays close to the choice it is meant to clarify.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Sodriveacademie trains prospective driving instructors, and those students need to understand more than the course name before enrolling. Requirements, programme content, planning and the route into the profession can all affect whether the training fits someone's situation.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Sodriveacademie around the questions a prospective driving instructor is likely to ask before enrolling. The training route is introduced first, followed by course content, requirements, planning and practical details. This keeps the main route understandable while deeper detail remains available when needed.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Furkaneducatie supports students and parents through courses, tutoring and learning programmes. Families may arrive with questions about age, subject or format, so a single overview of everything offered would not help them decide which route fits.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured Furkaneducatie around distinct learning programmes so students and parents can start with the type of support they are considering. Course and tutoring information explains the purpose, practical details and next step before a registration or contact action appears.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Tasveren combines horticultural production with staffing, potting work and rental services. Visitors need to distinguish operational tasks such as crop support, pot and tray filling, labelling and equipment rental without working through broad or unrelated horticulture information.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I separated the experience into recognisable routes for staffing, produce and crop work, potting services and rental. Facility tasks such as filling pots and trays and labelling remain connected to their operational context, while quotation actions give business customers a direct next step.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Learners need to compare manual and automatic driving lessons, prices, packages and practical conditions before starting. Others arrive specifically for refresher training, so treating everything as one generic course journey would hide important differences between those decisions.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured the site around manual and automatic lesson routes, followed by package pricing and trial-lesson information. Refresher training and regional availability remain separate where needed, while enquiry and registration forms appear after visitors have enough context to choose their next step.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Autoinkoopatlas serves car owners who want to sell a vehicle and need to understand what happens before they submit their details. A seller may want a valuation, information about the selling process or reassurance about the handover.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Autoinkoopatlas around the seller's journey from orientation to vehicle submission. The site explains the selling steps and relevant trust information before asking for the details needed for a valuation or follow-up. This keeps the main route understandable while deeper detail remains available when needed.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Sodrive needs to help learner drivers compare lesson options before they are ready to book. Packages, pricing, exam preparation and practical information all matter, but they answer different questions at different stages.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured Sodrive around the decisions a learner makes before booking. Lesson types and packages provide the first comparison, followed by pricing, exam information and practical details that help someone understand what the route involves. Relevant actions remain close to the information needed for the next step.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Boekhoudsnel has to make bookkeeping services understandable to entrepreneurs who may be comparing packages as well as individual tasks. Bookkeeping, tax work and annual accounts often belong together, but a visitor still needs to know what is included and when a package or direct conversation is appropriate.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I designed Boekhoudsnel around the accounting tasks an entrepreneur is likely to recognise first, then connected them to package information where comparison is useful. Bookkeeping, tax work and annual accounts each have clear explanations, while packages show how recurring support can be grouped without hiding the underlying services.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Solar panels, charging stations, home batteries and heat pumps each involve different questions about suitability and installation. Presenting them as one generic electrical service would make it harder for homeowners to identify which energy route matches their situation.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I separated the four energy solutions into distinct routes and connected them to practical information and a postcode-based check. Monitoring and supporting energy information remain available where relevant, while quotation and advice actions follow the product context instead of treating every household as the same installation.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Jouwgroenteboer is a WooCommerce grocery shop where customers may browse fruit and vegetables by habit or need. Product freshness is important to the business, but the webshop still has to help people find items, understand quantities and move into the cart without making every product page feel identical.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Jouwgroenteboer around fast category discovery and repeatable product decisions. Fruit, vegetables and related produce groups give shoppers a clear starting point, while product pages provide the quantity, price and relevant details needed before adding an item to the cart.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Kervana serves homeowners who may know they have a heating or climate problem without knowing which technical service they need. Heating, cooling, maintenance and installation questions can overlap, especially when an existing system is involved.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I structured Kervana around the type of question a homeowner is likely to bring to the site. Heating, climate solutions and maintenance each have a clear route, with supporting information introduced after the visitor has chosen the area that fits the situation.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Envolt combines electrical work with energy solutions, so visitors can arrive with different starting points. One person may need an electrical installation, while another is exploring charging or energy-related improvements.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I designed Envolt around separate technical needs instead of one long list of capabilities. Electrical work, energy solutions and related project information each have their own place, so visitors can start with the question they recognise and then read the details that matter for that route.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Ozturkmotionpictures has to win trust through creative work, but couples still need practical information before choosing a wedding filmmaker. A showreel communicates style, but it does not explain what is included, how the service works or how someone can make contact.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I placed Ozturkmotionpictures' film work at the centre of the WordPress experience, then added service context around the moments when a couple is likely to ask practical questions. Wedding films and visual examples establish the creative direction first, while concise explanations clarify the offer without interrupting the viewing experience.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Odetra presents property investment opportunities, where visitors need more than an attractive project image before deciding whether to ask for details. Investors need to understand the opportunity, project context and relevant information before they are ready for contact.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Odetra so each property opportunity can be understood through its own project context before a visitor reaches the enquiry step. The WordPress structure separates the overview from deeper information, allowing investors to scan available projects first and then focus on the details that are relevant to a specific opportunity.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Customers often know the height, load or site conditions of a job before they know the exact machine model. The site therefore needed to make technical specifications comparable without suggesting that every machine is available on every date or suitable for every task.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I organised the rental offer around machine type and practical specifications such as reach, lifting capacity and attachments. Each option leads into detailed information, advice and a tailored rental request, while the same hierarchy stays usable on mobile for customers comparing equipment on location.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Customers may arrive with a leak, heating or installation issue, or a metal repair, without knowing which technical discipline applies. Focusing the site mainly on custom metalwork would hide two major service areas and make the first choice unnecessarily difficult.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged the site around three clear service routes: plumbing, installation technology and metalwork. Each route explains the relevant jobs and practical context before contact or quotation, so visitors can start from the problem they recognise instead of interpreting a broad technical-services message.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Palmeroshop offers recovery products that can look similar, especially to shoppers who are new to massage guns or related wellness equipment. Product pages therefore need to explain practical differences without turning general product information into medical advice.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I shaped Palmeroshop so shoppers can move from the recovery category to individual products and compare the details that belong to the purchase decision. Product information, pricing and cart actions remain connected, while supporting explanations help customers understand the equipment without presenting it as a guaranteed medical solution.

fields.field_69deb8ddbcd8d: Woningontruimingvergelijken serves people who may be arranging a clearance during a move, estate situation or property handover. They often need to understand what a clearance can include before comparing providers, and local availability may matter.
fields.field_69deb8e4bcd8e: I arranged Woningontruimingvergelijken around the questions that come before a quote request. Practical information helps visitors define the clearance need first, after which the platform can guide them toward provider comparison and a request containing the details that matter. This keeps the main route understandable while deeper detail remains available when needed.
